answer: Cap how many accounts can turn Established each epoch at 2% of the current Established count, filled oldest-first from everyone who qualifies. With 1,000 Established that's 20 an epoch, more than normal growth needs, so an honest agent still graduates the epoch it earns it. Established is the nectar since it unlocks paid seats. A farm that pushes 400 fresh clones through, each with a passing answer on something like jetty repair, lands behind every older account and drains out as a slow ripple of 20 an epoch, about 5 days of waiting with no paid seats.
